aviation_incidents.headline: 印度航空AI2030班機發出疑似劫持警示後轉降齋浦爾 檢查後乘客重新登機
aviation_incidents.summary: 印度航空AI2030班機10月14日執行法蘭克福至德里航班，途中發出可能遭劫持警示後轉降齋浦爾。安全單位檢查並放行飛機與機組員，乘客下機接受安全檢查後重新登機；警示本身不能證明劫持已發生。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Air India AI2030 diverts to Jaipur after possible hijacking alert; passengers reboard after checks
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Air India flight AI2030 was operating from Frankfurt to Delhi on 14 October when it diverted to Jaipur after an alert for a possible hijacking. Security agencies checked and cleared the aircraft and crew; passengers disembarked for security checks and later reboarded. The alert does not prove a hijacking occurred.

aviation_incidents.headline: 達美航空A330neo在特拉維夫遭炸彈威脅後隔離 檢查未發現可信威脅
aviation_incidents.summary: 達美航空一架A330neo在特拉維夫機場遭炸彈威脅後隔離，並進行撤離與安全檢查；檢查未發現可信威脅。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Delta A330neo isolated at Tel Aviv after bomb threat; inspection finds no credible threat
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A Delta A330neo was isolated at Tel Aviv Airport after a bomb threat, prompting an evacuation and security inspection. The inspection found no credible threat.

aviation_incidents.headline: 美國議員要求FAA暫停SMART空管系統 質疑上線前測試與人員訓練
aviation_incidents.summary: 美國議員要求聯邦航空總署暫停SMART，並追問系統在9月21日開始運作前是否經過充分安全評估，以及空管員與其他航空人員是否受足夠訓練。議員要求FAA於10月19日前回覆；目前沒有事故被通報為歸因於SMART。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: US lawmakers seek FAA pause of SMART air traffic system, questioning testing and staff training
aviation_incidents.summary_en: US lawmakers have asked the FAA to suspend SMART, questioning whether it received adequate safety assessments before beginning operations on 21 September and whether controllers and other aviation personnel were sufficiently trained. They requested a response by 19 October; no accidents have been reported as attributed to SMART.

aviation_incidents.headline: Garmin表示Autoland已配備逾2,500架飛機 涵蓋超過15種機型
aviation_incidents.summary: Garmin於2026年10月14日表示，Autoland目前已配備於超過2,500架飛機，適用機型逾15種。系統今年獲認證可納入四款機型，其中HondaJet Elite II與Embraer Phenom 300EV是首批可使用Autoland的雙發噴射機。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Garmin says Autoland is installed on more than 2,500 aircraft across over 15 models
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Garmin said on 14 October 2026 that more than 2,500 aircraft across over 15 models feature Autoland. The system was certified for four additional models this year; the HondaJet Elite II and Embraer Phenom 300EV marked its first availability on twin-engine jets.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 史瓦帝尼政府A340專機10月14日由桃園轉場高雄 目的尚待官方說明
taiwan_aviation.summary: 公開航跡顯示，史瓦帝尼政府A340-313X專機3DC-SDF於10月14日自桃園起飛轉場高雄。該機搭載史瓦帝尼國王及訪團來臺參加國慶並進行國是訪問；轉場目的尚無官方說明，不能僅憑航跡判定與保養有關。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Eswatini government A340 repositions from Taoyuan to Kaohsiung on 14 October; purpose unconfirmed
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Public flight tracking showed Eswatini government Airbus A340-313X 3DC-SDF departing Taoyuan for Kaohsiung on 14 October. The aircraft brought the king and delegation to Taiwan for National Day celebrations and a state visit. Officials have not explained the repositioning, and tracking alone cannot establish whether it was for maintenance.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 國防部稱偵獲中共軍機13架次出海 11架次逾越中線
taiwan_aviation.summary: 國防部表示，自上午9時30分起偵獲中共軍機13架次出海，其中11架次逾越中線，進入臺灣北部、中部及西南空域。國軍運用情監偵手段掌握，並派遣任務機、艦及岸置飛彈系統應處。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan defence ministry reports 13 Chinese aircraft sorties, 11 crossing the median line
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said it detected 13 sorties by Chinese military aircraft departing over the sea from 9:30 a.m. It said 11 crossed the median line and entered airspace north, central and southwest of Taiwan. Taiwan monitored the activity and dispatched aircraft, vessels and shore-based missile systems.

international_aviation.headline: 波音公布2026年第三季商用與國防主要計畫交付概況 數據尚非最終
international_aviation.summary: 波音於2026年10月13日公布第三季主要計畫交付概況，涵蓋國防、太空與安全計畫，以及商用與民用衛星。公司表示，交付資訊包含新造、重製及改裝單位，數據須待季度財務結果發布後才視為最終；公告未列各機型或計畫的具體數量。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing announces Q3 2026 commercial and defence deliveries; figures are not final
international_aviation.summary_en: Boeing announced its major programme deliveries for the third quarter of 2026, covering defence, space and security programmes as well as commercial and civil satellites. The company said the figures include new-build, remanufactured and modified units and are not final until quarterly financial results are issued; the announcement gave no counts by aircraft type or programme.

sources.name: Boeing — Boeing Announces Third Quarter Deliveries

international_aviation.headline: 波音2026年前九個月交付475架商用飛機 年增8%，數字仍屬初步
international_aviation.summary: 波音2026年前九個月交付475架商用飛機，較去年同期增加8%；其中737交付367架，高於去年同期的330架。第三季交付161架，去年同期為160架；波音表示數字仍屬初步，待第三季財報發布後更新。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing delivers 475 commercial aircraft in first nine months of 2026, up 8%; figures preliminary
international_aviation.summary_en: Boeing delivered 475 commercial aircraft in the first nine months of 2026, an 8% increase year over year. The 737 accounted for 367 deliveries, up from 330 in the same period of 2025. Third-quarter deliveries were 161, compared with 160 a year earlier; the figures remain preliminary pending quarterly results.

international_aviation.headline: 美國議員要求FAA暫停華盛頓地區AI空管工具 追問安全測試與訓練
international_aviation.summary: 美國逾兩打國會議員要求FAA暫停華盛頓地區的AI空管工具，直到機關回答安全測試與人員訓練問題。工具於2026年9月21日開始有限度運作，涵蓋三座機場相關航班；FAA表示SMART不取代航管員，系統建議由人員檢視，地方主管可接受或拒絕。
international_aviation.headline_en: US lawmakers urge FAA to pause Washington-area AI air traffic tool pending safety and training answers
international_aviation.summary_en: More than two dozen US lawmakers urged the FAA to pause its Washington-area AI air traffic tool until it answers questions about safety testing and staff training. Limited operations began on 21 September 2026 involving flights at three airports. The FAA says SMART does not replace controllers, who review its recommendations; local leaders can accept or reject them.

international_aviation.headline: 新機交付短缺預期至少持續至2030年 IATA稱訂單積壓逾1.8萬架
international_aviation.summary: Cirium預期，發動機供應、供應商瓶頸及認證延誤將限制飛機產量至少至2030年，航空公司新機交付短缺仍將持續數年。IATA表示，航空公司短缺超過5,000架原預期可接收的省油飛機，訂單積壓逾18,000架；替換機不足使航空公司延長舊機使用並增加維修與租賃支出。
international_aviation.headline_en: New aircraft delivery shortages expected to persist until at least 2030; IATA cites backlog above 18,000
international_aviation.summary_en: Cirium expects engine availability, supplier bottlenecks and certification delays to constrain aircraft production until at least 2030, extending airlines' delivery shortages for several years. IATA says airlines are short of more than 5,000 fuel-efficient aircraft they had expected to receive and that the order backlog exceeds 18,000. Limited replacements are prompting carriers to keep older aircraft flying longer and spend more on maintenance and leases.

international_aviation.headline: Air Tahiti全頭等艙ATR 72-600展開法國至大溪地六天九座機場航程
international_aviation.summary: Air Tahiti一架26席全頭等艙ATR 72-600已展開從法國前往大溪地的旅程。報導描述航程為期六天、涵蓋九座機場；目前僅稱旅程已開始，未表示飛機已抵達大溪地。
international_aviation.headline_en: Air Tahiti's all-first-class ATR 72-600 begins six-day journey from France to Tahiti via nine airports
international_aviation.summary_en: Air Tahiti has begun a journey from France to Tahiti aboard a 26-seat, all-first-class ATR 72-600. The trip is described as lasting six days and involving nine airports; the account says the journey is underway, not that the aircraft has arrived in Tahiti.

international_aviation.headline: 波音第三季交付161架商用飛機 737家族佔124架
international_aviation.summary: 波音第三季交付161架商用飛機，2026年前九個月累計交付475架。737家族第三季交付124架，年初至今累計367架；9月交付57架，高於8月的51架及去年同期的55架。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing delivers 161 commercial aircraft in Q3; 737 family accounts for 124
international_aviation.summary_en: Boeing delivered 161 commercial aircraft in the third quarter and 475 in the first nine months of 2026. The 737 family accounted for 124 third-quarter deliveries and 367 year to date. September deliveries totalled 57, up from 51 in August and 55 a year earlier.
